channel.title: Rural Nevada: Upcoming Mass Gatherings
channel.description: Large upcoming events that may raise EMS call volume and hospital demand. Updated weekly. Each item shows a confidence level for its attendance figure.

item.title: Minden-Tahoe SkyFest, Minden (Douglas County), Oct 16-18, 2026 (Attendance figures unable to confirm)
item.description: No attendance figure found. County and tourism pages describe a 3-day air show at Minden-Tahoe Airport that draws visitors from Reno, Tahoe and Northern California. Expect more routine traveler medical calls, sun and cold evening exposure, crowded roads near the airport, and slower ambulance access. (Attendance figures unable to confirm)

item.title: Nevada Day Parade, Carson City (Carson City), Oct 31, 2026 (Attendance figures unable to confirm)
item.description: No attendance figure found. The organizer says only that the parade draws a large crowd to downtown Carson City. A large crowd in a small city can strain the local ED and EMS. Expect crowded downtown streets and slower ambulance access. (Attendance figures unable to confirm)
